nodes.name: check.py
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Checks in .cs files the coding rules that the build analyzer does not catch. Covers: `//` and `/* */` comments, TODO/FIXME/HACK, `!` (null-forgiving), `#pragma warning disable`, `.Result`, `.Wait()`, `async void`, `DateTime.Now`/`UtcNow` and `DateTimeOffset.Now`, lines over 120 columns, log with interpolation, `Result` without a generic type, status chosen by whoever instantiates Result<T>, DataAnnotations, `HandleAsync` without `Invalid` on the first line, `== null`/`!= null`, asynchronous method without the `Async` suffix and file without the CRLF terminator. The scan is by regex over the text without the contents of strings: there may be false positives, and the reviewer confirms. Usage: check.py <file-or-folder> [...] Output: one line `file:line: rule -> correct form` per deviation; at the end, the total. Exit code: 0 no deviations · 1 with deviations · 2 invalid input. Standard library only. """ import re import sys from pathlib import Path MAX_COLUMNS = 120 IGNORED_FOLDERS = {"bin", "obj", ".git", "node_modules", "Migrations"} RULES = [ ("slash-comment", re.compile(r"//(?!/)"), "`//` comment forbidden: only XML comments (`///`)"), ("block-comment", re.compile(r"/\*"), "`/* */` comment forbidden: only XML comments (`///`)"), ("pending-marker", re.compile(r"\b(TODO|FIXME|HACK)\b"), "no TODO/FIXME/HACK in the code"), ("null-forgiving", re.compile(r"[\w)\]]!(?=[.;,)\]\s])"), "no `!`: handle the null (`is not { } x`, `ThrowIfNull`)"), ("pragma", re.compile(r"#pragma\s+warning\s+disable"), "no `#pragma warning disable`: fix the code"), ("blocking-result", re.compile(r"\.Result\b(?!\s*[<(])"), "no `.Result`: use `await`"), ("blocking-wait", re.compile(r"\.Wait\s*\("), "no `.Wait()`: use `await`"), ("async-void", re.compile(r"\basync\s+void\b"), "no `async void`: return `Task`"), ("date-time", re.compile(r"\b(DateTime|DateTimeOffset)\.(Now|UtcNow)\b"), "use `TimeProvider` (`GetUtcNow()`)"), ("non-generic-result", re.compile(r"\bnew\s+Result\s*\(|Task<Result>"), "use `Result<T>` (`new Result<T>(...)`, `Task<Result<T>>`)"), ( "chosen-result-status", re.compile(r"\bResult(<\w+>)?\.(NotFound|Validation|Ok|Created|BadRequest)\b|new\s+Result<\w+>\(\s*HttpStatusCode"), "the status belongs to the `Result<T>` constructor; whoever instantiates does not choose it", ), ( "data-annotations", re.compile(r"System\.ComponentModel\.DataAnnotations|\[(property:\s*)?(AllowedValues|Range|Required|StringLength|MaxLength|MinLength|RegularExpression)\b"), "validate in the `Query`/`Command` constructor with Flunt notifications, without DataAnnotations", ), ( "comparison-with-null", re.compile(r"[!=]=\s*null\b"), "use `is null`/`is not null` (in an expression tree, such as Moq's `It.Is`, use another form without a pattern)", ), ] ASYNC_WITHOUT_SUFFIX = re.compile(r"\basync\s+(?:Task|ValueTask)(?:<.*?>)?\s+(\w+)\s*\(") IMPOSED_NAMES = {"Process", "Main"} INTERPOLATED_LOG = re.compile(r"\bLog(Trace|Debug|Information|Warning|Error|Critical)\s*\((?:[^;]*?,\s*)?\$@?\"") HANDLER = re.compile(r"Handler\.cs$") FIRST_STATEMENT_INVALID = re.compile(r"\s*\{\s*if\s*\(\s*\w+\.Invalid\s*\)") if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

", i) end = n if end < 0 else end output.append(" " * (end - i)) i = end elif text[i] in ""'": quote = text[i] if text.startswith('"""', i): end = text.find('"""', i + 3) end = n if end < 0 else end + 3 output.append("".join("
" if x == "
" else " " for x in text[i:end])) i = end continue verbatim = quote == '"' and i > 0 and text[i - 1] == "@" j = i + 1 while j < n: if text[j] == "\" and not verbatim: j += 2 continue if text[j] == quote: if verbatim and text.startswith(quote * 2, j): j += 2 continue break if text[j] == "
": break j += 1 middle = "".join("
" if x == "
" else " " for x in text[i + 1:j]) output.append(quote + middle + (quote if j < n and text[j] == quote else "")) i = j + 1 else: output.append(text[i]) i += 1 return "".join(output)

nodes.name: handle_without_invalid
nodes.body_text: def handle_without_invalid(cleaned): """Lines of the `HandleAsync` methods whose first statement is not `if (<input>.Invalid)`.""" lines = [] for found in re.finditer(r"\bHandleAsync\s*\(", cleaned): level, i = 1, found.end() while i < len(cleaned) and level: level += {"(": 1, ")": -1}.get(cleaned[i], 0) i += 1 if re.match(r"\s*\{", cleaned[i:]) and not FIRST_STATEMENT_INVALID.match(cleaned[i:]): lines.append(cleaned.count("\n", 0, found.start()) + 1) return lines

nodes.name: check_file
nodes.body_text: def check_file(path): original = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig") cleaned = clean(original) findings = [] if re.search(rb"(?<!\r)\n", path.read_bytes()): findings.append((1, "line-terminator", "CRLF line terminator (Windows standard)")) for number, (line, raw) in enumerate(zip(cleaned.splitlines(), original.splitlines()), start=1): if len(raw) > MAX_COLUMNS: findings.append((number, "columns", f"{len(raw)} columns: at most {MAX_COLUMNS}")) if INTERPOLATED_LOG.search(raw) and not raw.lstrip().startswith("///"): findings.append((number, "interpolated-log", "constant template with named placeholders, value as an argument")) for name, pattern, fix in RULES: if pattern.search(line): findings.append((number, name, fix)) method = ASYNC_WITHOUT_SUFFIX.search(line) if method and not method.group(1).endswith("Async") and method.group(1) not in IMPOSED_NAMES: findings.append((number, "async-without-suffix", "asynchronous method ends in `Async`, including tests")) if HANDLER.search(path.name): for number in handle_without_invalid(cleaned): findings.append((number, "handler-without-invalid", "the first line of `HandleAsync` is `if (query.Invalid)` and, on the line below, `return new Result<T>(query.Notifications);`")) return sorted(findings)

nodes.name: list_files
nodes.body_text: def list_files(entries): for entry in entries: p = Path(entry) if p.is_file() and p.suffix == ".cs": yield p elif p.is_dir(): for file in sorted(p.rglob("*.cs")): if not IGNORED_FOLDERS & set(file.parts): yield file else: print(f"invalid input: {entry}", file=sys.stderr) sys.exit(2)

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: def main(argv): sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8") if not argv: print(__doc__, file=sys.stderr) return 2 total = 0 for file in list_files(argv): for number, rule, fix in check_file(file): print(f"{file}:{number}: {rule} -> {fix}") total += 1 print(f"{total} deviation(s)") return 1 if total else 0

nodes.name: sync.py
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Compares the skill's references/standards/ with a project's docs/coding-standards/ and lists what diverged. The skill's files drop the `coding-standards-` prefix (`coding-standards.md` is `overview.md`), including in the cross-references inside the text. The comparison ignores the prefix of those references and the line terminator (CRLF or LF): only content changes count. Usage: sync.py <project-docs-coding-standards-folder> Output: one line per diverging file, with the first line that differs. Exit code: 0 in sync · 1 with divergence · 2 invalid input. Standard library only. Changes nothing. """ import re import sys from pathlib import Path NAMES = { "coding-standards.md": "overview.md", "coding-standards-compiler-and-naming.md": "compiler-and-naming.md", "coding-standards-csharp.md": "csharp.md", "coding-standards-style.md": "style.md", "coding-standards-tests.md": "tests.md", "coding-standards-build.md": "build.md", } REFERENCE = re.compile(r"coding-standards-([\w-]+\.md)") if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

nodes.name: normalize
nodes.body_text: def normalize(text, from_project): """Replaces the line terminator with LF and, in the project's text, strips the prefix from file names.""" text = text.replace("\r\n", "\n") if from_project: text = REFERENCE.sub(r"\1", text).replace("coding-standards.md", "overview.md") return text

Cobre: comentário `//` e `/* */`, TODO/FIXME/HACK, `!` (null-forgiving), `#pragma warning disable`, `.Result`, `.Wait()`, `async void`, `DateTime.Now`/`UtcNow` e `DateTimeOffset.Now`, linha acima de 120 colunas, log com interpolação, `Result` sem tipo genérico, status escolhido por quem instancia o Result<T>, DataAnnotations, `HandleAsync` sem `Invalid` na primeira linha, `== null`/`!= null`, método assíncrono sem sufixo `Async` e arquivo sem terminador CRLF. Uso: conferir.py <arquivo-ou-pasta> [...] Saída: uma linha `arquivo:linha: regra -> forma correta` por desvio; no fim, o total. Código de saída: 0 sem desvios · 1 com desvios · 2 entrada inválida. quem instancia não o escolhe", ), ( "data-annotations", re.compile(r"System\.ComponentModel\.DataAnnotations|\[(property:\s*)?(AllowedValues|Range|Required|StringLength|MaxLength|MinLength|RegularExpression)\b"), "valide no construtor do `Query`/`Command` com notificações do Flunt, sem DataAnnotations", ), ( "comparacao-com-null", re.compile(r"[!=]=\s*null\b"), "use `is null`/`is not null` (em árvore de expressão, como o `It.Is` do Moq, use outra forma sem padrão)", ), ] ASYNC_SEM_SUFIXO = re.compile(r"\basync\s+(?:Task|ValueTask)(?:<.*?>)?\s+(\w+)\s*\(") NOMES_IMPOSTOS = {"Process", "Main"} LOG_INTERPOLADO = re.compile(r"\bLog(Trace|Debug|Information|Warning|Error|Critical)\s*\((?:[^;]*?,\s*)?\$@?\"") HANDLER = re.compile(r"Handler\.cs$") PRIMEIRA_INSTRUCAO_INVALID = re.compile(r"\s*\{\s*if\s*\(\s*\w+\.Invalid\s*\)") if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

nodes.name: consolidate.py
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Consolidates the UI/UX inspection against the interface checklist and issues the verdict. Reads the 66 items from references/checklist.md, merges the inspection items.json files (the last file wins by id), applies the audit (which can only worsen a status), validates the evidence and writes the report. Output on stdout: one JSON line with the verdict, counts and pending items. Exit code: 0 approved or approved with pending items · 1 rejected or inconclusive · 2 invalid input. Standard library only. """ import argparse import json import re import sys from datetime import date from pathlib import Path STATUSES = ["OK", "OK (code)", "N/A", "Fail", "Not verified"] ORIGINS = ["implementation", "prototype", "undefined"] OPINIONS = ["confirmed", "downgraded", "insufficient"] MIN_TEXT = 10 ROW = re.compile(r"^\|\s*(\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2})\s*\|\s*(B)?\s*\|\s*(.+?)\s*\|") GROUP = re.compile(r"^##\s+(\d{1,2})\.\s+(.+?)\s*$") if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main())

nodes.name: load_checklist
nodes.body_text: def load_checklist(path): items, groups, current_group = [], {}, None for line in Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(): g = GROUP.match(line) if g: current_group = int(g.group(1)) groups[current_group] = g.group(2) continue r = ROW.match(line) if r and current_group is not None: items.append({"id": r.group(1), "group": current_group, "blocking": r.group(2) == "B", "item": r.group(3)}) return items, groups

nodes.name: text
nodes.body_text: def text(value): return value.strip() if isinstance(value, str) else ""

nodes.name: merge
nodes.body_text: def merge(files): meta, by_id = {"limits": []}, {} for file in files: data = json.loads(Path(file).read_text(encoding="utf-8")) m = data.get("meta", {}) for key, value in m.items(): if key == "limits": meta["limits"] += [x for x in value if x not in meta["limits"]] else: meta[key] = value for it in data.get("items", []): by_id[it.get("id")] = dict(it) return meta, by_id

nodes.name: validate
nodes.body_text: def validate(checklist_items, by_id, partial): errors, known = [], {i["id"] for i in checklist_items} for iid in by_id: if iid not in known: errors.append(f"{iid}: id not in the checklist") if not partial: for i in checklist_items: if i["id"] not in by_id: errors.append(f"{i['id']}: no status (all 66 items are required)") for iid, it in by_id.items(): if iid not in known: continue st = it.get("status") if st not in STATUSES: errors.append(f"{iid}: invalid status {st!r} (use {', '.join(STATUSES)})") continue evid, reason = text(it.get("evidence")), text(it.get("reason")) if st in ("OK", "OK (code)", "Fail") and len(evid) < MIN_TEXT: errors.append(f"{iid}: {st} requires `evidence` (what was seen or done, with the path)") if st in ("OK (code)", "N/A", "Not verified") and len(reason) < MIN_TEXT: errors.append(f"{iid}: {st} requires `reason`") if st in ("Fail", "Not verified") and not text(it.get("next_step")): errors.append(f"{iid}: {st} requires `next_step`") if st == "Fail" and it.get("origin") not in ORIGINS: errors.append(f"{iid}: Fail requires `origin` ({', '.join(ORIGINS)})") return errors

nodes.name: apply_audit
nodes.body_text: def apply_audit(by_id, path): errors, audited = [], [] data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")) for a in data.get("items", []): iid, opinion = a.get("id"), a.get("opinion") if iid not in by_id: errors.append(f"audit {iid}: item without inspection") continue if opinion not in OPINIONS: errors.append(f"audit {iid}: invalid opinion {opinion!r}") continue it = by_id[iid] if opinion == "confirmed" or it.get("status") in ("Fail", "Not verified"): it["audited"] = "confirmed" if opinion == "confirmed" else it.get("audited") continue note = text(a.get("evidence")) if len(note) < MIN_TEXT: errors.append(f"audit {iid}: {opinion} requires `evidence`") continue previous = it["status"] if opinion == "insufficient": new = "Not verified" it["reason"] = f"Insufficient evidence in the audit: {note}" else: new = a.get("proposed_status") if new not in ("Fail", "Not verified"): errors.append(f"audit {iid}: `proposed_status` must be Fail or Not verified") continue if new == "Fail": it["evidence"] = f"Audit: {note}" if a.get("origin") in ORIGINS: it["origin"] = a["origin"] it.setdefault("origin", "undefined") else: it["reason"] = f"Audit: {note}" it["next_step"] = text(a.get("next_step")) or text(it.get("next_step")) \ or "Re-inspect the item with the evidence the audit asked for." it["status"], it["audited"] = new, f"downgraded from {previous}" return errors

nodes.name: verdict
nodes.body_text: def verdict(checklist_items, by_id): fail_b = [i["id"] for i in checklist_items if i["blocking"] and by_id[i["id"]]["status"] == "Fail"] nv_b = [i["id"] for i in checklist_items if i["blocking"] and by_id[i["id"]]["status"] == "Not verified"] pend = [i["id"] for i in checklist_items if not i["blocking"] and by_id[i["id"]]["status"] in ("Fail", "Not verified")] if fail_b: return "REJECTED", fail_b, nv_b, pend if nv_b: return "INCONCLUSIVE", fail_b, nv_b, pend return ("APPROVED WITH PENDING ITEMS" if pend else "APPROVED"), fail_b, nv_b, pend

nodes.name: cell
nodes.body_text: def cell(value): return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(value)).replace("|", "\\|").strip()

nodes.name: description
nodes.body_text: def description(it): st = it["status"] parts = [] if st in ("OK", "Fail"): parts.append(it.get("evidence", "")) elif st == "OK (code)": parts.append(f"{it.get('evidence', '')} Reason: {it.get('reason', '')}") else: parts.append(it.get("reason", "")) if it.get("shot"): parts.append(f"Screenshot: `{it['shot']}`.") if st == "Fail" and it.get("origin"): parts.append(f"Origin: {it['origin']}.") if it.get("audited"): parts.append(f"Audit: {it['audited']}.") return cell(" ".join(p for p in parts if p))

nodes.name: report
nodes.signature: def report(meta, checklist_items, groups, by_id, partial, res)
nodes.body_text: def report(meta, checklist_items, groups, by_id, partial, res): ver, fail_b, nv_b, pend = res n_b = sum(1 for i in checklist_items if i["blocking"]) counts = {s: sum(1 for i in checklist_items if i["id"] in by_id and by_id[i["id"]]["status"] == s) for s in STATUSES} total = sum(counts.values()) L = [f"# UI/UX approval: {meta.get('screen', '(screen not provided)')}", ""] L.append("Rule applied: interface checklist " f"({len(groups)} groups, {len(checklist_items)} items, {n_b} blocking). " "Ruler: `references/checklist.md` of the fsd-ui-approval skill.") for label, key in (("Application", "app"), ("Build", "build"), ("Prototype", "prototype"), ("Profiles", "profiles"), ("Driver", "driver"), ("Date", "date")): if meta.get(key): L.append(f"{label}: {meta[key]}.") L += ["", "Legend: **OK** = seen on the screen. **OK (code)** = from the code only, with the reason. " "**N/A** = does not apply (reason). **Fail** = does not meet the item. " "**Not verified** = no evidence (reason). **[B]** = blocking.", ""] if meta.get("limits"): L += ["Limits of this verification:"] + [f"- {x}" for x in meta["limits"]] + [""] for g, title in groups.items(): L += [f"## {g}. {title}", "", "| Item | Status | Evidence |", "|---|---|---|"] for i in checklist_items: if i["group"] != g or i["id"] not in by_id: continue it = by_id[i["id"]] label = ("[B] " if i["blocking"] else "") + i["item"] L.append(f"| {i['id']} {cell(label)} | {it['status']} | {description(it)} |") L.append("") L += ["## Summary", ""] L.append(f"{total} items: " + ", ".join(f"**{counts[s]} {s}**" for s in STATUSES) + ".") L.append("") if partial: L += ["**Partial consolidation: not a verdict.** Checklist items are missing.", ""] else: L += [f"**Verdict: {ver}.**", ""] L.append("Blocking items with Fail: " + (", ".join(fail_b) if fail_b else "none") + ".") L.append("Blocking items Not verified: " + (", ".join(nv_b) if nv_b else "none") + ".") L.append("Non-blocking items with Fail or Not verified: " + (", ".join(pend) if pend else "none") + ".") L += ["", "Verdict rule: any blocking item with Fail rejects; with no blocking Fail, any " "blocking item Not verified leaves the consolidation inconclusive; only non-blocking " "pending items approve with pending items.", ""] adverse = [i for i in checklist_items if i["id"] in by_id and by_id[i["id"]]["status"] in ("Fail", "Not verified")] adverse.sort(key=lambda i: (not i["blocking"], [int(x) for x in i["id"].split(".")])) L += ["## Pending items", ""] if not adverse: L.append("None.") else: L += ["| # | Item | Pending item | Blocking | Origin | Next step |", "|---|---|---|---|---|---|"] for n, i in enumerate(adverse, 1): it = by_id[i["id"]] cause = it.get("evidence") if it["status"] == "Fail" else it.get("reason") L.append(f"| {n} | {i['id']} | {it['status']}: {cell(cause)} | " f"{'Yes' if i['blocking'] else 'No'} | {it.get('origin', '-')} | " f"{cell(it.get('next_step', ''))} |") return "\n".join(L) + "\n", counts

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: def main(): root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter) ap.add_argument("--items", nargs="+", required=True, help="inspection items.json; the last wins by id") ap.add_argument("--audit", help="audit.json from fsd-ui-auditor") ap.add_argument("--checklist", default=str(root / "references" / "checklist.md")) ap.add_argument("--out", help="path of report.md") ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true", help="accepts a subset of the items and issues no verdict (inspector self-check)") args = ap.parse_args() checklist_items, groups = load_checklist(args.checklist) if len(checklist_items) != 66: print(json.dumps({"error": f"checklist has {len(checklist_items)} items, expected 66"})) return 2 try: meta, by_id = merge(args.items) meta.setdefault("date", date.today().isoformat()) errors = validate(checklist_items, by_id, args.partial) if args.audit and not errors: errors += apply_audit(by_id, args.audit) errors += validate(checklist_items, by_id, args.partial) except (OSError, ValueError) as e: print(json.dumps({"error": str(e)}, ensure_ascii=False)) return 2 if errors: print(json.dumps({"error": "invalid input", "details": errors}, ensure_ascii=False)) return 2 present = [i for i in checklist_items if i["id"] in by_id] res = verdict(present, by_id) report_md, counts = report(meta, checklist_items, groups, by_id, args.partial, res) if args.out: Path(args.out).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) Path(args.out).write_text(report_md, encoding="utf-8") ver, fail_b, nv_b, pend = res print(json.dumps({"verdict": "PARTIAL" if args.partial else ver, "counts": counts, "blocking_fail": fail_b, "blocking_not_verified": nv_b, "non_blocking_pending": pend, "report": args.out}, ensure_ascii=False)) return 0 if args.partial or ver in ("APPROVED", "APPROVED WITH PENDING ITEMS") else 1

nodes.name: conferir.py
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Confere em arquivos .cs as regras de codificação que o analisador do build não pega. Cobre: comentário `//` e `/* */`, TODO/FIXME/HACK, `!` (null-forgiving), `#pragma warning disable`, `.Result`, `.Wait()`, `async void`, `DateTime.Now`/`UtcNow` e `DateTimeOffset.Now`, linha acima de 120 colunas, log com interpolação, `Result` sem tipo genérico, status escolhido por quem instancia o Result<T>, DataAnnotations, `HandleAsync` sem `Invalid` na primeira linha, `== null`/`!= null`, método assíncrono sem sufixo `Async` e arquivo sem terminador CRLF. A varredura é por regex sobre o texto sem o conteúdo de strings: pode haver falso positivo, e quem revisa confirma. Uso: conferir.py <arquivo-ou-pasta> [...] Saída: uma linha `arquivo:linha: regra -> forma correta` por desvio; no fim, o total. Código de saída: 0 sem desvios · 1 com desvios · 2 entrada inválida. Só biblioteca padrão. """ import re import sys from pathlib import Path MAX_COLUNAS = 120 PASTAS_IGNORADAS = {"bin", "obj", ".git", "node_modules", "Migrations"} REGRAS = [ ("comentario-barra", re.compile(r"//(?!/)"), "comentário `//` proibido: só comentário XML (`///`)"), ("comentario-bloco", re.compile(r"/\*"), "comentário `/* */` proibido: só comentário XML (`///`)"), ("pendencia", re.compile(r"\b(TODO|FIXME|HACK)\b"), "sem TODO/FIXME/HACK no código"), ("null-forgiving", re.compile(r"[\w)\]]!(?=[.;,)\]\s])"), "sem `!`: trate o nulo (`is not { } x`, `ThrowIfNull`)"), ("pragma", re.compile(r"#pragma\s+warning\s+disable"), "sem `#pragma warning disable`: corrija o código"), ("result-bloqueante", re.compile(r"\.Result\b(?!\s*[<(])"), "sem `.Result`: use `await`"), ("wait-bloqueante", re.compile(r"\.Wait\s*\("), "sem `.Wait()`: use `await`"), ("async-void", re.compile(r"\basync\s+void\b"), "sem `async void`: devolva `Task`"), ("data-hora", re.compile(r"\b(DateTime|DateTimeOffset)\.(Now|UtcNow)\b"), "use `TimeProvider` (`GetUtcNow()`)"), ("result-nao-generico", re.compile(r"\bnew\s+Result\s*\(|Task<Result>"), "use `Result<T>` (`new Result<T>(...)`, `Task<Result<T>>`)"), ( "result-status-escolhido", re.compile(r"\bResult(<\w+>)?\.(NotFound|Validacao|Ok|Created|BadRequest)\b|new\s+Result<\w+>\(\s*HttpStatusCode"), "o status é do construtor do `Result<T>`; quem instancia não o escolhe", ), ( "data-annotations", re.compile(r"System\.ComponentModel\.DataAnnotations|\[(property:\s*)?(AllowedValues|Range|Required|StringLength|MaxLength|MinLength|RegularExpression)\b"), "valide no construtor do `Query`/`Command` com notificações do Flunt, sem DataAnnotations", ), ( "comparacao-com-null", re.compile(r"[!=]=\s*null\b"), "use `is null`/`is not null` (em árvore de expressão, como o `It.Is` do Moq, use outra forma sem padrão)", ), ] ASYNC_SEM_SUFIXO = re.compile(r"\basync\s+(?:Task|ValueTask)(?:<.*?>)?\s+(\w+)\s*\(") NOMES_IMPOSTOS = {"Process", "Main"} LOG_INTERPOLADO = re.compile(r"\bLog(Trace|Debug|Information|Warning|Error|Critical)\s*\((?:[^;]*?,\s*)?\$@?\"") HANDLER = re.compile(r"Handler\.cs$") PRIMEIRA_INSTRUCAO_INVALID = re.compile(r"\s*\{\s*if\s*\(\s*\w+\.Invalid\s*\)") if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

", i) fim = n if fim < 0 else fim saida.append(" " * (fim - i)) i = fim elif texto[i] in ""'": aspa = texto[i] if texto.startswith('"""', i): fim = texto.find('"""', i + 3) fim = n if fim < 0 else fim + 3 saida.append("".join("
" if x == "
" else " " for x in texto[i:fim])) i = fim continue verbatim = aspa == '"' and i > 0 and texto[i - 1] == "@" j = i + 1 while j < n: if texto[j] == "\" and not verbatim: j += 2 continue if texto[j] == aspa: if verbatim and texto.startswith(aspa * 2, j): j += 2 continue break if texto[j] == "
": break j += 1 miolo = "".join("
" if x == "
" else " " for x in texto[i + 1:j]) saida.append(aspa + miolo + (aspa if j < n and texto[j] == aspa else "")) i = j + 1 else: saida.append(texto[i]) i += 1 return "".join(saida)

nodes.name: handle_sem_invalid
nodes.body_text: def handle_sem_invalid(limpo): """Linhas dos `HandleAsync` cuja primeira instrução não é `if (<entrada>.Invalid)`.""" linhas = [] for achado in re.finditer(r"\bHandleAsync\s*\(", limpo): nivel, i = 1, achado.end() while i < len(limpo) and nivel: nivel += {"(": 1, ")": -1}.get(limpo[i], 0) i += 1 if re.match(r"\s*\{", limpo[i:]) and not PRIMEIRA_INSTRUCAO_INVALID.match(limpo[i:]): linhas.append(limpo.count("\n", 0, achado.start()) + 1) return linhas

nodes.name: conferir_arquivo
nodes.body_text: def conferir_arquivo(caminho): original = caminho.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig") limpo = limpar(original) achados = [] if re.search(rb"(?<!\r)\n", caminho.read_bytes()): achados.append((1, "terminador-de-linha", "terminador de linha CRLF (padrão Windows)")) for numero, (linha, bruta) in enumerate(zip(limpo.splitlines(), original.splitlines()), start=1): if len(bruta) > MAX_COLUNAS: achados.append((numero, "colunas", f"{len(bruta)} colunas: no máximo {MAX_COLUNAS}")) if LOG_INTERPOLADO.search(bruta) and not bruta.lstrip().startswith("///"): achados.append((numero, "log-interpolado", "template constante com placeholders nomeados, valor como argumento")) for nome, padrao, correcao in REGRAS: if padrao.search(linha): achados.append((numero, nome, correcao)) metodo = ASYNC_SEM_SUFIXO.search(linha) if metodo and not metodo.group(1).endswith("Async") and metodo.group(1) not in NOMES_IMPOSTOS: achados.append((numero, "async-sem-sufixo", "método assíncrono termina em `Async`, inclusive teste")) if HANDLER.search(caminho.name): for numero in handle_sem_invalid(limpo): achados.append((numero, "handler-sem-invalid", "a primeira linha do `HandleAsync` é `if (query.Invalid)` e, na linha de baixo, `return new Result<T>(query.Notifications);`")) return sorted(achados)

nodes.name: listar
nodes.body_text: def listar(entradas): for entrada in entradas: p = Path(entrada) if p.is_file() and p.suffix == ".cs": yield p elif p.is_dir(): for arquivo in sorted(p.rglob("*.cs")): if not PASTAS_IGNORADAS & set(arquivo.parts): yield arquivo else: print(f"entrada inválida: {entrada}", file=sys.stderr) sys.exit(2)

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: def main(argv): sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8") if not argv: print(__doc__, file=sys.stderr) return 2 total = 0 for arquivo in listar(argv): for numero, regra, correcao in conferir_arquivo(arquivo): print(f"{arquivo}:{numero}: {regra} -> {correcao}") total += 1 print(f"{total} desvio(s)") return 1 if total else 0

nodes.name: sincronia.py
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Compara references/padroes/ da skill com docs/padroes-codigo/ de um projeto e lista o que divergiu. Os arquivos da skill perdem o prefixo `padroes-codigo-` (`padroes-codigo.md` é `visao-geral.md`), inclusive nas referências cruzadas dentro do texto. A comparação ignora o prefixo dessas referências e o terminador de linha (CRLF ou LF): só conta o que mudou de conteúdo. Uso: sincronia.py <pasta-docs-padroes-codigo-do-projeto> Saída: uma linha por arquivo divergente, com a primeira linha que difere. Código de saída: 0 em sincronia · 1 com divergência · 2 entrada inválida. Só biblioteca padrão. Não altera nada. """ import re import sys from pathlib import Path NOMES = { "padroes-codigo.md": "visao-geral.md", "padroes-codigo-compilador-e-nomes.md": "compilador-e-nomes.md", "padroes-codigo-csharp.md": "csharp.md", "padroes-codigo-estilo.md": "estilo.md", "padroes-codigo-testes.md": "testes.md", "padroes-codigo-build.md": "build.md", } REFERENCIA = re.compile(r"padroes-codigo-([\w-]+\.md)") if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

nodes.name: normalizar
nodes.body_text: def normalizar(texto, do_projeto): """Troca o terminador de linha por LF e, no texto do projeto, tira o prefixo dos nomes de arquivo.""" texto = texto.replace("\r\n", "\n") if do_projeto: texto = REFERENCIA.sub(r"\1", texto).replace("padroes-codigo.md", "visao-geral.md") return texto

nodes.name: consolidar.py
nodes.body_text: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Consolida a inspeção de UI/UX contra o checklist de interface e emite o veredito. Lê os 66 itens de references/checklist.md, junta os itens.json da inspeção (o último arquivo vence por id), aplica a auditoria (que só pode piorar um status), valida as evidências e escreve o relatório. Saída em stdout: uma linha JSON com veredito, contagens e pendências. Código de saída: 0 aprovado ou aprovado com pendências · 1 reprovado ou não concluído · 2 entrada inválida. Só biblioteca padrão. """ import argparse import json import re import sys from datetime import date from pathlib import Path STATUS = ["OK", "OK (código)", "N/A", "Falha", "Não verificado"] ORIGENS = ["implementacao", "prototipo", "indefinida"] PARECERES = ["confirmado", "rebaixado", "insuficiente"] MIN_TEXTO = 10 ROW = re.compile(r"^\|\s*(\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2})\s*\|\s*(B)?\s*\|\s*(.+?)\s*\|") GRUPO = re.compile(r"^##\s+(\d{1,2})\.\s+(.+?)\s*$") if __name__ == "__main__": sys.exit(main())

nodes.name: carregar_checklist
nodes.body_text: def carregar_checklist(caminho): itens, grupos, grupo_atual = [], {}, None for linha in Path(caminho).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(): g = GRUPO.match(linha) if g: grupo_atual = int(g.group(1)) grupos[grupo_atual] = g.group(2) continue r = ROW.match(linha) if r and grupo_atual is not None: itens.append({"id": r.group(1), "grupo": grupo_atual, "bloqueante": r.group(2) == "B", "item": r.group(3)}) return itens, grupos

nodes.name: texto
nodes.body_text: def texto(valor): return valor.strip() if isinstance(valor, str) else ""

nodes.name: juntar
nodes.body_text: def juntar(arquivos): meta, por_id = {"limites": []}, {} for arq in arquivos: dados = json.loads(Path(arq).read_text(encoding="utf-8")) m = dados.get("meta", {}) for chave, valor in m.items(): if chave == "limites": meta["limites"] += [x for x in valor if x not in meta["limites"]] else: meta[chave] = valor for it in dados.get("itens", []): por_id[it.get("id")] = dict(it) return meta, por_id

nodes.name: validar
nodes.body_text: def validar(itens_checklist, por_id, parcial): erros, conhecidos = [], {i["id"] for i in itens_checklist} for iid in por_id: if iid not in conhecidos: erros.append(f"{iid}: id fora do checklist") if not parcial: for i in itens_checklist: if i["id"] not in por_id: erros.append(f"{i['id']}: sem status (todos os 66 itens são obrigatórios)") for iid, it in por_id.items(): if iid not in conhecidos: continue st = it.get("status") if st not in STATUS: erros.append(f"{iid}: status inválido {st!r} (use {', '.join(STATUS)})") continue evid, mot = texto(it.get("evidencia")), texto(it.get("motivo")) if st in ("OK", "OK (código)", "Falha") and len(evid) < MIN_TEXTO: erros.append(f"{iid}: {st} exige `evidencia` (o que foi visto ou feito, com o caminho)") if st in ("OK (código)", "N/A", "Não verificado") and len(mot) < MIN_TEXTO: erros.append(f"{iid}: {st} exige `motivo`") if st in ("Falha", "Não verificado") and not texto(it.get("proximo_passo")): erros.append(f"{iid}: {st} exige `proximo_passo`") if st == "Falha" and it.get("origem") not in ORIGENS: erros.append(f"{iid}: Falha exige `origem` ({', '.join(ORIGENS)})") return erros

nodes.name: aplicar_auditoria
nodes.body_text: def aplicar_auditoria(por_id, caminho): erros, auditados = [], [] dados = json.loads(Path(caminho).read_text(encoding="utf-8")) for a in dados.get("itens", []): iid, parecer = a.get("id"), a.get("parecer") if iid not in por_id: erros.append(f"auditoria {iid}: item sem inspeção") continue if parecer not in PARECERES: erros.append(f"auditoria {iid}: parecer inválido {parecer!r}") continue it = por_id[iid] if parecer == "confirmado" or it.get("status") in ("Falha", "Não verificado"): it["auditado"] = "confirmado" if parecer == "confirmado" else it.get("auditado") continue nota = texto(a.get("evidencia")) if len(nota) < MIN_TEXTO: erros.append(f"auditoria {iid}: {parecer} exige `evidencia`") continue anterior = it["status"] if parecer == "insuficiente": novo = "Não verificado" it["motivo"] = f"Evidência insuficiente na auditoria: {nota}" else: novo = a.get("status_proposto") if novo not in ("Falha", "Não verificado"): erros.append(f"auditoria {iid}: `status_proposto` deve ser Falha ou Não verificado") continue if novo == "Falha": it["evidencia"] = f"Auditoria: {nota}" if a.get("origem") in ORIGENS: it["origem"] = a["origem"] it.setdefault("origem", "indefinida") else: it["motivo"] = f"Auditoria: {nota}" it["proximo_passo"] = texto(a.get("proximo_passo")) or texto(it.get("proximo_passo")) \ or "Reinspecionar o item com a evidência que a auditoria pediu." it["status"], it["auditado"] = novo, f"rebaixado de {anterior}" return erros

nodes.name: veredito
nodes.body_text: def veredito(itens_checklist, por_id): falha_b = [i["id"] for i in itens_checklist if i["bloqueante"] and por_id[i["id"]]["status"] == "Falha"] nv_b = [i["id"] for i in itens_checklist if i["bloqueante"] and por_id[i["id"]]["status"] == "Não verificado"] pend = [i["id"] for i in itens_checklist if not i["bloqueante"] and por_id[i["id"]]["status"] in ("Falha", "Não verificado")] if falha_b: return "REPROVADO", falha_b, nv_b, pend if nv_b: return "NÃO CONCLUÍDO", falha_b, nv_b, pend return ("APROVADO COM PENDÊNCIAS" if pend else "APROVADO"), falha_b, nv_b, pend

nodes.name: celula
nodes.body_text: def celula(valor): return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(valor)).replace("|", "\\|").strip()

nodes.name: descricao
nodes.body_text: def descricao(it): st = it["status"] partes = [] if st in ("OK", "Falha"): partes.append(it.get("evidencia", "")) elif st == "OK (código)": partes.append(f"{it.get('evidencia', '')} Motivo: {it.get('motivo', '')}") else: partes.append(it.get("motivo", "")) if it.get("shot"): partes.append(f"Captura: `{it['shot']}`.") if st == "Falha" and it.get("origem"): partes.append(f"Origem: {it['origem']}.") if it.get("auditado"): partes.append(f"Auditoria: {it['auditado']}.") return celula(" ".join(p for p in partes if p))

nodes.name: relatorio
nodes.signature: def relatorio(meta, itens_checklist, grupos, por_id, parcial, res)
nodes.body_text: def relatorio(meta, itens_checklist, grupos, por_id, parcial, res): ver, falha_b, nv_b, pend = res n_b = sum(1 for i in itens_checklist if i["bloqueante"]) cont = {s: sum(1 for i in itens_checklist if i["id"] in por_id and por_id[i["id"]]["status"] == s) for s in STATUS} total = sum(cont.values()) L = [f"# Aprovação de UI/UX: {meta.get('tela', '(tela não informada)')}", ""] L.append("Regra aplicada: checklist de interface " f"({len(grupos)} grupos, {len(itens_checklist)} itens, {n_b} bloqueantes). " "Régua: `references/checklist.md` da skill fsd-ui-approval.") for rotulo, chave in (("Aplicação", "app"), ("Build", "build"), ("Protótipo", "prototipo"), ("Perfis", "perfis"), ("Driver", "driver"), ("Data", "data")): if meta.get(chave): L.append(f"{rotulo}: {meta[chave]}.") L += ["", "Legenda: **OK** = visto na tela. **OK (código)** = só pelo código, com o motivo. " "**N/A** = não se aplica (motivo). **Falha** = descumpre o item. " "**Não verificado** = sem evidência (motivo). **[B]** = bloqueante.", ""] if meta.get("limites"): L += ["Limites desta verificação:"] + [f"- {x}" for x in meta["limites"]] + [""] for g, titulo in grupos.items(): L += [f"## {g}. {titulo}", "", "| Item | Status | Evidência |", "|---|---|---|"] for i in itens_checklist: if i["grupo"] != g or i["id"] not in por_id: continue it = por_id[i["id"]] rot = ("[B] " if i["bloqueante"] else "") + i["item"] L.append(f"| {i['id']} {celula(rot)} | {it['status']} | {descricao(it)} |") L.append("") L += ["## Resumo", ""] L.append(f"{total} itens: " + ", ".join(f"**{cont[s]} {s}**" for s in STATUS) + ".") L.append("") if parcial: L += ["**Consolidação parcial: não é veredito.** Faltam itens do checklist.", ""] else: L += [f"**Veredito: {ver}.**", ""] L.append("Bloqueantes com Falha: " + (", ".join(falha_b) if falha_b else "nenhum") + ".") L.append("Bloqueantes Não verificado: " + (", ".join(nv_b) if nv_b else "nenhum") + ".") L.append("Não bloqueantes com Falha ou Não verificado: " + (", ".join(pend) if pend else "nenhum") + ".") L += ["", "Regra do veredito: qualquer bloqueante com Falha reprova; sem Falha bloqueante, qualquer " "bloqueante Não verificado deixa a consolidação não concluída; só pendência não bloqueante " "aprova com pendências.", ""] adversos = [i for i in itens_checklist if i["id"] in por_id and por_id[i["id"]]["status"] in ("Falha", "Não verificado")] adversos.sort(key=lambda i: (not i["bloqueante"], [int(x) for x in i["id"].split(".")])) L += ["## Pendências", ""] if not adversos: L.append("Nenhuma.") else: L += ["| # | Item | Pendência | Bloqueante | Origem | Próximo passo |", "|---|---|---|---|---|---|"] for n, i in enumerate(adversos, 1): it = por_id[i["id"]] causa = it.get("evidencia") if it["status"] == "Falha" else it.get("motivo") L.append(f"| {n} | {i['id']} | {it['status']}: {celula(causa)} | " f"{'Sim' if i['bloqueante'] else 'Não'} | {it.get('origem', '-')} | " f"{celula(it.get('proximo_passo', ''))} |") return "\n".join(L) + "\n", cont

nodes.name: main
nodes.body_text: def main(): raiz = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter) ap.add_argument("--itens", nargs="+", required=True, help="itens.json da inspeção; o último vence por id") ap.add_argument("--auditoria", help="auditoria.json do fsd-ui-auditor") ap.add_argument("--checklist", default=str(raiz / "references" / "checklist.md")) ap.add_argument("--out", help="caminho do relatorio.md") ap.add_argument("--parcial", action="store_true", help="aceita subconjunto dos itens e não emite veredito (conferência do inspetor)") args = ap.parse_args() itens_checklist, grupos = carregar_checklist(args.checklist) if len(itens_checklist) != 66: print(json.dumps({"erro": f"checklist com {len(itens_checklist)} itens, esperado 66"})) return 2 try: meta, por_id = juntar(args.itens) meta.setdefault("data", date.today().isoformat()) erros = validar(itens_checklist, por_id, args.parcial) if args.auditoria and not erros: erros += aplicar_auditoria(por_id, args.auditoria) erros += validar(itens_checklist, por_id, args.parcial) except (OSError, ValueError) as e: print(json.dumps({"erro": str(e)}, ensure_ascii=False)) return 2 if erros: print(json.dumps({"erro": "entrada inválida", "detalhes": erros}, ensure_ascii=False)) return 2 presentes = [i for i in itens_checklist if i["id"] in por_id] res = veredito(presentes, por_id) texto_md, cont = relatorio(meta, itens_checklist, grupos, por_id, args.parcial, res) if args.out: Path(args.out).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) Path(args.out).write_text(texto_md, encoding="utf-8") ver, falha_b, nv_b, pend = res print(json.dumps({"veredito": "PARCIAL" if args.parcial else ver, "contagens": cont, "bloqueantes_falha": falha_b, "bloqueantes_nao_verificado": nv_b, "pendencias_nao_bloqueantes": pend, "relatorio": args.out}, ensure_ascii=False)) return 0 if args.parcial or ver in ("APROVADO", "APROVADO COM PENDÊNCIAS") else 1
